LanguageData.LP_AdventurersManual.label: adventurer's manual
LanguageData.LP_AdventurersManual.description: A well-thumbed little book recording the many paths of Faerûn's adventurers. After reading: your next adventurer class ignores skill requirements (and the adventurer level 3 multiclass requirement), and you gain some training XP (up to adventurer level 3). Can only be read while you have fewer than 3 classes and no unused waiver. Each book can be used only once.
